test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

He asked if I had been aware of the policies of the company.

options.text: He said, "Did you be aware of the policies of the company?"
He said, "Were you awared of the policies of the company?"
He said, "Was you aware of the policies of the company?"
He said, "Were you aware of the policies of the company?"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked if I had been aware of the policies of the company.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if I had been aware" becomes "Were you aware"**
 
 
• Indirect question "if I had been aware" is converted to direct question "Were you aware."
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb tense "had been" is changed to "were" to match direct speech format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Were" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Were you aware of the policies of the company?" he asked.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Did you be aware of the policies of the company?" 

 
 
• Incorrect verb usage: "Did you be aware" is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Were you awared of the policies of the company?" 
 
 
• Incorrect verb form: "awared" is not a valid word.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Was you aware of the policies of the company?" 
 
 
• Incorrect subject-verb agreement: "Was you" is grammatically incorrect.
